# Ledger Event

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:LedgerEvent`](gmeow-LedgerEvent.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/LedgerEvent>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/attestation`](../../slices/attestation.md)
- **Box roles:** [CBox role](../boxes/cbox.md), [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

An event emitted by a smart contract or recorded on a ledger — a log entry, oracle callback, or bridge message.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Event`](gmeow-Event.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:LedgerEvent`](gmeow-LedgerEvent.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Event`](gmeow-Event.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:Event`](gmeow-Event.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to model an event emitted on-chain — a smart-contract log, oracle callback, or bridge message — as the occurrent perspective of ledger activity, distinct from the transaction that produced it.

### Avoid when

- Avoid for the transaction record itself (that is [`gmeow:LedgerTransaction`](gmeow-LedgerTransaction.md), an [`InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md)) and avoid treating an emitted event as real-world truth — it proves only that the contract logged it under chain rules.

### How to use

- Mint the event with [`gmeow:logIndex`](../properties/gmeow-logIndex.md) (the EL minimum) naming its position in the block/transaction, link it to its emitting [`gmeow:SmartContract`](gmeow-SmartContract.md), and let its temporal extent ride on the [gufo:Event](../../external/terms.md#gufo-event) spine.

### Examples

- ex:transferEvent a [`gmeow:LedgerEvent`](gmeow-LedgerEvent.md); [`gmeow:logIndex`](../properties/gmeow-logIndex.md) 3.
